method: Local javap inspection of the exact cached game binary used by the experiment.

findings.finding: Play sends level event 1010 with position and song registry ID. Stop sends event 1011. tick calls stop when song.hasFinished(ticksSinceSongStarted).
Returns true at lengthInTicks() + 20 ticks. At nominal 20 TPS this is one second of grace beyond the declared song duration.
Complete buffers are cached by sound resource identifier using computeIfAbsent. Streams open independent audio decoders. clear disposes cached buffers and clears the map.
stopAll does not clear the decoded buffer library. destroy clears it, and reload calls destroy before reloading the library. Buffered tracks can accumulate across ordinary playback stops.
Streaming queues four chunks initially and removes processed buffers during pumping. Long-run source offset measurements must include the durations of removed buffers.

limits: Code inspection establishes behavior in this binary; it is not a runtime test of automatic end-of-song stopping or resource-pack delivery to an unmodified client.
